verdict.rationale: The published pages describe SOSPortal as an account-based platform, with multi-factor authentication, saved drafts and a My Submissions page. Nothing documents a keyless or file-number entry path into the core filing flow. The only no-account items are downloadable PDF forms and a certificate-verification service, which are adjacent features rather than a keyless online filing path.

support.subject: As a founder, I can start the core online flow without creating an account first — the service's published pages document a keyless or file-number entry path
